summary: Validated Conducta Extendida feature end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest PASS (template GET/PUT with all validations, scores list/save with admin permissions, libreta integration). Frontend: tutor portal renders 'Eval. Conductual Extendida' tab correctly with 2 sections (EVALUACIÓN CONDUCTUAL 4 criterios + PARTICIPACIÓN DE PP.FF. 3 criterios), PROM. column at the end (auto-calculated: 16.57 verified for Acuña Peralta Cesar with 18/18/16/19/15/14/16), 252 score inputs (36 alumnos × 7 criterios), Guardar button present. The libreta payload includes metadata.conducta_template_mode + conducta_extendida.{mode,template,by_period} as designed.

issues: Column header is 'PROM.' (abbreviated). The PRD said 'PROMEDIO'. Cosmetic — header is truncated for screen real estate, value rendering is correct.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/conducta_extendida.py uses `body.dict()` which is deprecated in Pydantic v2 (line 212) — prefer `model_dump()`. Works today via the compat shim, but emits DeprecationWarning. Low priority.
MisTutoriasPage.jsx is 1163 lines — over the 700-line guideline; consider extracting <SectionDashboard/> wrapper around the tab content area.

The `seccion_id` field on students appears to be hidden from /api/students/{id} (returns 404 for owner/admin). Not blocking the feature, but the test fixture had to fall back to /api/libreta to resolve section_id — this could trip up integrators who expect students CRUD to expose the section assignment.
seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded student 63cd034b-1b68-446f-b8f7-6d3589a709f1 (Acuña Peralta Cesar) in BIMESTRE I (093a0bee-92c4-449c-b82c-942f16847759). Tests overwrite scores for that student; no orphan rows produced thanks to the unique index (school_id, student_id, period_id). admin can save into a closed bimestre (tutor cannot — verified by 423 in code path).

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — additive feature, no bugs found.
